# BillingNoticeKind

What a billing notice is about.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"OutOfCredit"` | The tenant is out of credit: nothing new starts, and what was running is stopped, until it tops up or upgrades. |
| `"CreditRestored"` | The tenant has credit again after being out of it: work can start again. |
| `"AllowanceUsed"` | On a plan without top-ups, one allowance is used up for the billing period (see `meter`). |
| `"LowBalance"` | The balance fell below the tenant's low-balance alert. |
| `"PaymentFailed"` | A renewal payment failed: the tenant is on Free now, and its data is kept as it is until `frozenUntilUtc`. Paying the renewal before then puts it back on `previousTier`. |
| `"FreezeReminder"` | A reminder, 7, 21 and 28 days after a failed renewal payment, that it is still unpaid (see `frozenUntilUtc`). |
| `"FreezeEnded"` | The time to pay a failed renewal ran out: the subscription is cancelled, and Free's limits apply in full. |
| `"PlanRestored"` | A failed renewal was paid: the tenant is back on `tier`. |
| `"PlanChanged"` | The plan changed: a subscription started, an upgrade, or a change booked for the renewal took effect (see `tier`). |
| `"MovedToFree"` | The subscription ended (cancelled, or its payments gave up): the tenant is on Free. |
| `"AutoTopUpFailed"` | An automatic top-up couldn't be charged, so automatic top-ups are off until the card or the settings are saved again. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`BillingNotice`](billing-notice.md)
